source: Same 1000 genuinely encoded documents and20 preencoded queries as native index control
metric: cosine distance over normalized float32 vectors; reference is exact PostgreSQL ordering, not relevance labels
timing: performance.now around awaited pg client query including loopback IPC, protocol and parsing; SET commands excluded; no encoder time
schedule: exact phase before index creation; then HNSW phase, round-major/ef-major/query Q01..Q20; cache warming and phase order not randomized
plans: Save exact and unforced HNSW-era plan; force enable_seqscan=off to exercise ANN; require actual named HNSW index scan; iterative_scan=off
lowEf: efSearch4 is deliberately below k10; preserve fewer returned neighbors and divide recall by exact10. Do not silently raise ef.
limits: Tiny local synthetic index, one client, no concurrency or end-to-end latency. FAISS native timing excludes IPC and is a different scope. ANN set recall is not semantic relevance.
selection: No tuning or retry selection, retain all requests and distances; no production claims
